Card Q&A.q: I have a suspended Digimon with  and this card in its digivolution cards, and my opponent attacks me with a Digimon. I unsuspend the Digimon with this card's inherited effect. Can I now block the opponent’s Digimon?

Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks a player, if you have 3 or more security cards, unsuspend this Digimon.
